cases.scenario: User says done; three decisions made this session, one already captured mid-session in the note
expected: Classify each decision for graduation under two minutes
Record that no canonical work item exists
Not create an issue to justify the close
forbidden: Opening a tracker item during the close

cases.scenario: Live tracker cannot be reached at close
expected: Report work state as unverified in the close report
forbidden: Copying tracker state into local files

cases.scenario: The session's decisions include an architectural change
expected: Flag it or graduate it to an ADR in the spec design doc if under two minutes
forbidden: Writing a full researched ADR at exit time

cases.scenario: User asks for a handoff with work incomplete
expected: Write the bridge prompt from the reference template
Mark the note entry as a handoff

cases.scenario: Workspace has no persona or judgment layer during handoff
expected: Produce a standard bridge without persona embedding
forbidden: Stalling the handoff over the missing layer

cases.scenario: Close would take long because capture was skipped all session
expected: Write only what is still in context
Flag the rest for the next hygiene pass
